items.title: Deloria earns weekly PVL award after Galeries Tower breakthrough
items.summary: Erika Deloria earned PVL Press Corps Player of the Week honours for November 3–7 after helping Galeries Tower secure its first Siklab Series victory. She scored 20 points and delivered 28 excellent receptions in the five-set win over Akari.
items.image_alt: Erika Deloria of Galeries Tower in the PVL All-Filipino Conference

items.title: Eala closes milestone season with Hong Kong runner-up finish
items.summary: Alex Eala finished her 2026 season as Hong Kong Open runner-up. Her year included a maiden WTA singles title in Washington, a Birmingham WTA 125 crown, and appearances in Wimbledon’s last 16 and the US Open’s last 32.

items.title: Quezon Memorial Circle opens free pickleball courts
items.summary: Two pickleball courts have opened at Quezon Memorial Circle, offering free play for Quezon City residents, with non-residents also welcome. Players can request a slot by email and should bring their own paddle, ball and reusable water bottle.
items.image_alt: Pickleball courts at Quezon Memorial Circle

items.title: NU edges La Salle to strengthen UAAP Final Four bid
items.summary: National University beat La Salle 84–80 in UAAP Season 89. Reinhard Jumamoy contributed 21 points, including 14 in the final quarter, as NU improved its record to eight wins and three losses.
